highlights.title: Switch between This Mac and your servers
highlights.text: Press ⌘⇧O (Ctrl+Shift+O on Windows and Linux) and pick a place. The window switches in place, and the place you left stays connected, so its nudges still reach you.

highlights.title: Continue a chat in a new one
highlights.text: Press ⋯ under a message in a one-bot chat and choose Continue in a new chat from here. The new chat has the same bot and everything up to that message.

highlights.title: Long chats stay smooth while a bot writes
highlights.text: A reply that's still coming in now redraws once per frame, and only that message, so a long chat keeps scrolling smoothly while a bot types.

highlights.title: Only you answer your bots' questions
highlights.text: A bot can no longer answer a question meant for you, its own or another bot's. Your answers from the app and Telegram work as before.

highlights.title: A done line that never claims too much
highlights.text: When a finished task has a criterion no part covered, its line says so, like "1 criterion not met", instead of reading as fully checked.

highlights.title: Blocked catches an ask next to an offer
highlights.text: After a failed step, a reply like "Paste the output, and let me know if it fails" shows as Blocked, and one that only offers more help doesn't.
